g.text: Command forwarded to the owner replica — PATCH /api/airports/{iata}/status (US109; same for US106a, US208)
Unicast: peers are tried ONE AT A TIME.
Same method, path, body and JWT; X-Peer-Hops: 1.
Single owner: each airport has exactly one copy, so replicas never have conflicting versions.
Owner answers 4xx (e.g. 409 certification already exists) → same status to the client.
No replica has the airport → 404. No peer answers → 503.
